claim_text: Cardholder asserts merchandise was not delivered to the address specified on the order.

evidence_bundle.content: Consignment EK4471209 was delivered on 22 July 2026 at 12:18 IST. The record includes the recipient signature, the printed recipient name matching the cardholder, a doorstep photograph showing the flat number, and OTP verification from the registered mobile.
The courier handset maintained a GPS fix within eight metres of the delivery address throughout the delivery event.
Six prior orders on this account were delivered to the same address without dispute.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts the order was never received.

evidence_bundle.content: The parcel shows a delivered scan on 1 August 2026. The proof of delivery document is missing from the courier's portal and the courier has been unable to retrieve it.
The shipping address matches the billing address.

claim_text: Cardholder states the goods never arrived and disputes the charge.

evidence_bundle.content: The courier's final scan reads 'delivered' with no supporting artefacts of any kind: no signature, no photograph, no OTP and no recipient name.
The customer reported non-receipt within twenty-four hours of the scan.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts non-receipt of merchandise.

evidence_bundle.content: The delivery record shows OTP verification completed at 15:44 IST on 9 August 2026 from the mobile number registered on the account.
The address matches the billing address and has been used twice before.
The customer opened a support chat on 10 August 2026 asking about warranty registration for the delivered item.

claim_text: Cardholder contends the merchandise received was materially different from the listing.

evidence_bundle.content: The archived listing, the order line and the dispatch scan all record the same SKU and specification.
The dispatch weight matches the SKU master weight to within twenty grams.
The customer did not identify which listed attribute was inaccurate despite two requests.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts the item did not match its description in a specific respect.

evidence_bundle.content: The listing states a capacity that the supplier's specification sheet for the shipped batch does not support.
The merchant amended the listing on 10 August 2026 following an internal review that confirmed the original figure was incorrect.

claim_text: Cardholder contends the goods were not as described at the point of sale.

evidence_bundle.content: The listing and the shipped SKU agree. The customer's complaint refers to an attribute described in a third-party review linked from the listing page rather than in the merchant's own description.
The merchant offered a return under its standard policy; the customer declined and raised the dispute instead.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts the delivered goods were defective on arrival.

evidence_bundle.content: The customer reported a fault on the day of delivery with photographs showing a damaged component.
The merchant's policy provides replacement or refund for delivery damage reported within forty-eight hours. Neither was provided and the ticket was closed without resolution.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a single purchase produced two charges.

evidence_bundle.content: The account holds two orders with the same value placed six days apart, each with its own order number, its own consignment and its own delivery date.
Both consignments have independent proofs of delivery with different dates and different signatures.

claim_text: Cardholder disputes what they believe is a duplicated debit.

evidence_bundle.content: Two captures of the same value exist two days apart against the same order reference. The merchant's ledger records the second as a 'manual capture' with no operator identifier and no note.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a repeated charge for one service engagement.

evidence_bundle.content: Two charges appear in the same month. The merchant states one relates to a deposit and one to the balance, but the invoice for the deposit cannot be located.
The engagement letter references a deposit but does not state its amount.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts an unauthorised transaction on their account.

evidence_bundle.content: The transaction was completed with 3-D Secure authentication from the registered mobile, and originated from the account's long-standing primary device.
The account has a five-year history with no prior disputes and the delivery address is unchanged since registration.
The order was delivered and signed for at that address on 16 July 2026.

claim_text: Cardholder states the transaction was fraudulent.

evidence_bundle.content: The order was placed from a device flagged by the merchant's risk provider as associated with prior confirmed fraud on other merchants.
The delivery address was created during the checkout session and is a commercial forwarding address.
The parcel was delivered to that forwarding address and onward shipped by the forwarder.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts they did not make this purchase.

evidence_bundle.content: The device fingerprint is new to the account but the IP address falls within the same residential subnet used for the account's prior six orders.
The item was delivered to the account's saved address with a signature captured but no recipient name.

claim_text: Issuer requests clarification of two charges of similar value on the cardholder's account.

evidence_bundle.content: The two charges relate to two distinct orders placed nine days apart with different contents and different delivery addresses.
Confirmation emails for both orders were sent and opened.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a subscription charge followed a valid cancellation.

evidence_bundle.content: The cancellation is recorded on 20 July 2026 and the disputed charge on 5 July 2026, fifteen days earlier, covering the period 5 July to 4 August.
The cancellation confirmation stated that access would continue to 4 August 2026 and that no further charge would follow.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts continued billing after requesting cancellation.

evidence_bundle.content: The customer emailed a cancellation request on 3 June 2026 to the merchant's published support address. The email is present in the merchant's mailbox archive.
The request was never actioned and two further charges were raised on 1 July and 1 August 2026.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a subscription renewed without adequate notice.

evidence_bundle.content: A renewal notice was sent thirty-one days before the renewal date and the email service provider records it as delivered. There is no open event.
The merchant's terms require thirty days' notice, which was met. The terms were accepted at signup.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a trial converted despite an attempted cancellation.

evidence_bundle.content: Application telemetry shows the customer opened the cancellation screen on the final day of the trial and spent forty seconds there before the session ended.
No cancellation event was recorded and the conversion charge was raised the following day.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts an agreed refund was never credited.

evidence_bundle.content: Refund rfnd_80201 was processed on 14 July 2026 to the original instrument and appears as accepted in the acquirer settlement file dated 17 July 2026.
The acquirer reference number was provided to the customer by email on 17 July 2026.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a refund is outstanding following a return.

evidence_bundle.content: The return was delivered to the merchant's returns centre on 8 July 2026 and signed for.
The goods receipt was recorded on 11 July 2026 and the item passed inspection. The refund was approved internally on 12 July 2026 but no gateway transaction was created.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts a refund amount was less than agreed.

evidence_bundle.content: The refund issued was the order value less a return shipping fee of Rs 150, which the merchant's returns policy applies to change-of-mind returns.
The return reason recorded by the customer was 'no longer needed'. The shipping fee is stated on the returns portal.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts the merchandise was not delivered.

evidence_bundle.content: The delivered scan is supported by a photograph showing a parcel inside a doorway. No house number, name plate or other identifying feature is visible.
The handset GPS at the scan places the agent within the building footprint, which contains eleven flats.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts they received nothing for this charge.

evidence_bundle.content: The consignment was delivered on 28 July 2026 with OTP verification, a signature, and a photograph showing the recipient holding the parcel at a door bearing the flat number from the order.
The account has nine prior undisputed deliveries to this address.

claim_text: Cardholder contends the item was not as advertised.

evidence_bundle.content: The listing archive and the shipped specification agree in all recorded fields.
The customer's stated grievance concerns delivery timing rather than the description of the goods.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts the product differs from what was advertised.

evidence_bundle.content: The listing archive is available but the images associated with it were served from a content delivery network whose cache for that period has expired. Only the text description can be verified.
The customer's complaint concerns the appearance of the item rather than its written specification.

claim_text: Cardholder does not recognise this charge.

evidence_bundle.content: The transaction is a recurring charge under a mandate created eleven months earlier from the cardholder's account.
Pre-debit notifications were sent before each of the eleven prior charges, all delivered, none disputed.
The mandate creation session used the account's primary device.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts an unfamiliar charge from this merchant.

evidence_bundle.content: The order was placed under an email address similar to but not identical to the cardholder's registered address, differing by a single transposed character.
The item was delivered to the cardholder's billing address on 2 August 2026.

claim_text: Issuer maintains the merchant has not evidenced valid consent to the recurring charge.

evidence_bundle.content: The mandate record includes a consent timestamp and IP address but the merchant cannot produce the consent text as displayed at the time.
Pre-debit notifications were sent and delivered before each charge.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts they were charged twice for one booking.

evidence_bundle.content: The booking record shows one charge. A second charge of the same value on the same day belongs to a separate booking made by a different account holder sharing the same billing card.
Both bookings issued confirmations to different email addresses.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts an order placed was never delivered.

evidence_bundle.content: The consignment's delivered scan carries a recipient name that does not match the cardholder and an address line that differs from the order at the street level.
No address amendment was requested by the customer.

claim_text: Cardholder asserts no credit was received for a returned item.

evidence_bundle.content: The return was received on 3 July 2026 and the refund was issued on 4 July 2026 to the original card, settling on 7 July 2026 per the acquirer file.
A refund confirmation email with the reference number was sent on 4 July 2026 and opened on 5 July 2026.
